description: Compact workflow plus verbatim rules; v48 base names and derived-object names require complete independent antecedents, preserving mathematical/statistical qualifiers, actual head span and object identity. Source-supported base-reference plus an explicit operation is distinct from naming a derived object; no automatic split on de, invented definitions, dropped qualifiers or substring passes. Sync claims/solution and valid counts in existing checks. All v45/v43/v44 and earlier limits retained; source edits require renewed coverage review. v50 consolidates full-object coverage, deduplication, identical notation and authorized normalization without removing existing boundaries; independently review this condensed summary and its conditional routes before release. v52 flowchart terminology covers actual raster/vector/editable text, reused figures and internal titles without protected-name exemption; source-grounded renaming preserves object and flow semantics, outside official names remain protected, and existing visual review/routes are reused. Unaffected valid internal titles and existing name protection outside flowchart scope remain unchanged. v53 routes renderer distortion to the frozen, verified same-DOCX compatibility backend before altering source-correct math; all six checks and actual final-page independent review remain required. v54: current coverage combines actual independent checks and controller-verified inheritance of previously passed unaffected scopes; source/dependency changes and changed/new/unreviewed pages remain inspected. Review coverage replaces repeated full review, not correctness requirements. No extra model or ledger. v59 numeric sign/operator notation is mirrored in worker-standard with source preservation, scope/operand/format exceptions and existing review reuse; independently review these changed routes before release. v60 replaces forced bare-letter math with plain body text even for source-bound references; complete structured/special symbols retain math and body-sized inline display, distinct from reduced display equations. Original source/display evidence, whole equations, and existing checks remain; review the changed routes independently.
